notes.title: The FULL version is OUT NOW
notes.content:
We're happy to announce that our main game is out on PC!
Our team has worked days and nights and is proud to present you the game for those who are hungry for adventures!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44732507/913a9ef1141e41a2919f736b176bbd6a4c1bee8f.jpg[/img]
We hope you'll enjoy this sci-fi journey through parallel worlds full of puzzles, mysteries, and different creatures. We're always here to help you, so don't hesitate to contact us if there's any unpredictable issue. Let's stay in touch here, on Steam, or on [url=https://twitter.com/take_aim_games]Twitter[/url] or [url=https://discord.gg/KMy8SjvYja]Discord[/url]!

notes.title: Update #2 is here!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, it’s time for a new update!

We’ve considered your invaluable feedback about the Foreword, and here are a few changes we’d like to present to you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44732507/df603e3fb1924208623e847794bda6e413184db8.jpg[/img]
[h3]The Muller-Powell Principle: Foreword Update #2 Changelist:[/h3]

[b]General:[/b]
- Increased player’s crouching speed
- Added an option for changing movement controls to any you want
- Added a visual when you try to pick up a fast-flying object 
- Fixed an issue with reflected door signs
- Fixed other major bugs

[b]The prologue:[/b]
- Added dialogue backlog in the pause menu

[b]The station:[/b]
- Reduced the distance to the shaft with the falling barrels, so it’s now more clear that you can reach them
- Set custom control “instant gun discharge” for the R button (only for the new players)
- Increased time for gun discharging tutorial
- We’ve cut some of Eugene’s lines to match the game setting better
- Improved visual indication for some objects in the game
- Changed some objects to avoid player’s misleading

As always, let us know what you think! And thanks for all your support and anticipation!

notes.title: Update #1 Loading...
notes.content:
Hi all! We hope you’ve enjoyed The Muller-Powell Principle: Foreword as much as you’re waiting for the full game! 

As for the Foreword, we carefully read all your reviews and sincerely appreciate your feedback. Your insights and opinions are invaluable to us; they're the driving force behind our continuous efforts to ensure an exceptional gaming experience. We’re asking you to go on reporting any notable issues so we can make the upcoming game more dazzling.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44732507/6ae14610764119aefedb4a5c044e539696bb78ed.png[/img]

[h3]The Muller-Powell Principle: Foreword Update #1 Changelist[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added mouse inversion
[*] Added warning about photosensitivity/epilepsy seizures
[*] Fixed a series of bugs found by players
[*] Minor improvements
[/list]
